name: Oakville Limited Spring 2018

venue.name: [OE Banquet Hall & Conference Centre](http://www.oebanquet.com/)
venue.details: The competition will be held in the conference hall.

information: The competition is limted to 200 competitors.  Registration is [here](http://www.canadiancubing.com/Events/OLSp2018/Registration/). You must pay the registration fee to secure your spot.  Fees start at $15. Registration starts on Tuesday Feb 27 at 9 AM.
